cobblemon.species.brutebonnet-mega.desc: A towering cap, veined with glowing light, grows from the back of a great reptile. Spores drift from it like smoke, and its jaws can crush stone.
cobblemon.species.fluttermane-mega.desc: Its feathered mane streams like a banner and strings of beads hang from its brim. It drifts silently, singing a song no one can recall afterwards.
cobblemon.species.greattusk-mega.desc: Its tusks have grown into great curling blades and its stone-hard hide bristles with crimson crystals. Ancient records describe it charging through mountains.
cobblemon.species.screamtail-mega.desc: Its fur has grown into a great curling mane and its tail into a soft, swirling sphere. Its scream is said to have shaken whole valleys.
cobblemon.species.slitherwing-mega.desc: Its wings have grown into great blazing sails that scatter embers when it strikes. It was said to bring the dawn.
